name: Mordo

abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Counter-Attack Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Steadfast: Aktifken, Unblockable saldırılar sanki değillermiş gibi bloklanabilir.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Soul Barb: Aktifken, etkilenen şampiyon üzerindeki her buff için saniyede enerji hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Detonate: Süresi dolduğunda veya Nullify edildiğinde enerji hasarı patlaması verir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Pasif güç kazanımına dikkat et, sersemlemişken vurma (kaçar). Güç kontrolcüleri veya petrify erişimi olan şampiyonlar en iyisi.
signatureAbility:
Mystical Barrier
By conjuring a magical barrier, Mordo gains [7,055.32 - 24,821.12] Energy Resistance while he remains Blocking.
If the opponent strikes Mordo's Block while they have a True-Type Buff, he has a [70 - 173.23]% chance to Nullify that Buff and replace it with a Detonate Buff lasting 20 second(s). Detonate deals a burst of [6,981.1] Energy Damage when it's Nullified or Expires.
immunityDetails: • Silme (Nullify) Bağışıklığı (Mystic'lere karşı, Wong ile sinerji) 🔮

abilitySections.title: Astral Form - Always Active
content: Mordo is Immune to Passive Ability Accuracy reductions.
While the opponent has at least 1 Buff, gain +[1,994.6] Attack Rating.

Every 8 second(s), Mordo gains a Power Gain Buff granting 1 Bar of Power over 5 second(s). This Buff is removed if Mordo is struck. If fighting as a Defender, Mordo will behave less aggressively while this Buff is active.

abilitySections.title: While Stunned
content: When attacked by a Basic Attack while suffering from a Stun Debuff, Mordo will Purify the Stun and Evade the hit with a Counter-Attack that inflicts a Degeneration Debuff dealing [7,978.4] Direct Damage over 2.5 seconds.
Mordo cannot Evade or counter-attack while suffering from a Concussion or Fatigue Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Blocking
content: If Mordo holds Block for more than 0.5 second(s), his Block will not be broken by Unblockable Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: While Charging a Heavy Attack
content: Continually gain Fury Buffs, each granting +[1,994.6] Attack Rating for 17 second(s). Max: 15 Buffs. Exponentially gain more Buffs the longer the Heavy Attack is charged.
If Mordo is below 1 Bar of Power, he will Passively gain 0.5 Bar(s) of Power per second.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 30% chance to inflict a 3 second Stun Debuff.
100% chance to inflict a Degeneration Debuff, causing [7,978.4] Direct Damage over 2.5 second(s). If the opponent has at least 1 Buff, this effect can be triggered through a Block.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to inflict a [1,196.76] potency Soul Barb Debuff for 14 seconds. Mordo also reduces the Regeneration Rate of Soul Barbed Opponents by 80%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to gain 3 Fury Buffs, each granting +[4,986.5] Attack Rating for 17 second(s).
Up to 50% chance based on lost Health to gain a Regeneration Buff in place of a Fury Buff, recovering [20,412.3] Health over 6 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Mystical Barrier
content: By conjuring a magical barrier, Mordo gains [7,055.32 - 24,821.12] Energy Resistance while he remains Blocking.

If the opponent strikes Mordo's Block while they have a True-Type Buff, he has a [70 - 173.23]% chance to Nullify that Buff and replace it with a Detonate Buff lasting 20 second(s). Detonate deals a burst of [6,981.1] Energy Damage when it's Nullified or Expires.
